notes: Every FilterParams variant and all 47 GalleryFilter variants reach real Rust CPU kernels. No algorithm placeholder found in these paths.
Filter last repeat, smart filter conversion and WASM plugin dispatch are execution/document concepts, not pixel algorithms.
0.4 includes distinct CameraRawFilter and LensFilter APIs with the Photocraft relative-temperature and encoded-lens contracts.
No Neural Filters algorithm exists; only roadmap/parity discussion.
Puppet and Perspective are Edit/SmartObjects menu operations recorded as smart filters.
